Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
J. Andrew Lipscomb wrote:

> Can anyone think of a deck that can handle Weenie Hacking Bleed/Zip
> Gun/DBR/Amaranth? The only ones I can think of even possibly are
> cel/tha
> heavy on the Blood Rage and Blood Fury, and Toreador guns plus dodge.
>

Any good Vote deck with lots of bribed Domain Challenges (You have a LOT
of minions, really...). Combine this with Protected Recources (your
weeny friend can bleed you only for 2 per minion) and Parity Shifts
(what, you STILL have more pool than I do?). Voter Cap pushes back your
pool in favorable dimensions.

Along with some Rotschrecks & Prevention / Dodge cards, you should make
him a good game. Reduce bleeds, bleed bounce and Obediance will also
make his life a miserable one.

Especially Ventrue can also work with Dawn Op & Fortitude Prevention to
discourage blockers.

So use Ventrue or Toreador. (Perhaps one of them with Atonement, Flack
Jacket & Guardian Angel if your blocker has to take Dragonbreath
Damage).

Last but not least:

Take a look at cards like:

- Heart of Darkness (Setite, Deck: Combined with Ventrue)
Vamp can change ALL aggro damage in normal damage

- Reform Body (Tzimisce, Deck: Animalism Untap, Block All with
Atonement)
If your vamp is burned, you only go into Torpor. Amaranth is not
successful.

- Fast Reaction & Hidden Lurker (in case those weenies still stand)
- Drawing out the Beast (Cannot use their petty Zip Guns)
- Leather Jacket
Dragon Breath Rounds modify the weapon strike damage, so it is STILL
damage from the strike. Prevent it with Leather Jacket (and you untap
after equipping)

This is probably the best counter: He needs 3 cards to make his combo
effective
(Bleed Card, Zip Gun, DBR), you need only 1 to counter. He will run out
of cards eventually.
- Apparition (Ravnos, Animalism Untap with Atonement)
- Spiritual Protector (Giovanni, use: Carlotta Giovanni)

Last but not least:

Don't block, construct a faster Weeny Bleeder. (Pre Obf, just Pre, Pre
Dom)
Don't block, attack first: Brujah with Acrobatics and Sewer Lids...

There may be many more

Michael Beer
